blocks.text: Matthew 7:12 states a reciprocal command: act toward others as you would want them to act toward you. It cannot legitimately be used to excuse abuse, stigmatize disability or mental illness, enforce misogyny or anti-LGBTQ harm, blame poverty, set apocalyptic dates, or map ancient judgments onto modern peoples.

The statement that Jesus had “finished these words” at 7:28 belongs to a repeated formula that marks the ends of large teaching collections in Matthew. Five such endings organize these collections, though readers differ over whether they establish a single symbolic outline for the book.
